headline.title: 月之暗面发布 Kimi K3.1 Pro，承诺 11 月 4 日前开放权重
headline.summary: Kimi K3.1 Pro 已上线 Kimi API，暂未开放权重，月之暗面承诺 11 月 4 日前发布完整权重；同步推出速度快 2 至 3 倍、价格翻倍的 Highspeed 版本，美国定价每百万 token 2 美元起。
headline.title_en: Moonshot releases Kimi K3.1 Pro, promises open weights by November 4
headline.summary_en: Kimi K3.1 Pro is now available on the Kimi API but not yet open-weight; Moonshot promises full weights by Nov. 4, 2026, plus a 2–3x faster Highspeed version at double the price, with US pricing from $2 per million tokens.

headline.reason_en: Covers a new model launch, open-weight timeline, and pricing, fitting frontier model releases.
